name: Sword x Staff
summary: Welcome to the world of Kanstein, where your adventure is what you make it!
description:
Sword x Staff is a one-of-a-kind RPG — a “Third Way RPG.”
Strategy, massive world exploration, idle—why pick one when you can have it all?
Go hardcore, or just vibe—either way, you’ll find your own kind of fun here. The kind that actually feels different.
No pressure, no one way to play—just jump in, explore, and let the adventure click your way.
Curious what the gameplay is really like?
So, welcome to the unique world of Kanstein, and experience the one-of-a-kind Third Way adventure. Here, you are the Chosen Adventurer transported to this isekai! Team up with the Staff and Sword Twins and dive into a quest to save the world. Pierce through thick fog, dig up forgotten treasures, and explore a huge interactive world at your own pace. Mix and match over 200 skills to create a fighting style that’s uniquely yours. Best of all, you’ll meet amazing allies to fight by your side against legendary Hieromons! Of course—Remember, all of this can be enjoyed completely pressure-free, since the idle gameplay making resource gathering a breeze！ 
[Idle Game, but with a massive interactive world] 
Most idle games have you waiting. Sword x Staff lets you actually go somewhere.
Step into a huge world map where every region has its own vibe and secrets to uncover. Roam the lush wilds of Verdantglade, face the clash of steel and instinct in Cinder Ridge, drift through the mist-shrouded waters of Aqualis, and uncover the ancient bronze ruins hidden within Loong Haven.
Every region brings new sights, companions, treasures, and those "just one more look" moments. And even when you're offline, your adventure doesn't stop. Resources keep piling up while you rest, and the Traveling Merchant shows up with rare goods while you're away. Log back in, cash out, and keep going. 
[Deep strategy, but easy to jump in] 
Strategy is fun because of freedom, not because it needs a spreadsheet.
Everything starts with the classic Warrior & Mage dual-class system, branching into 200+ skill combinations and playstyles. Mix skills, change cast order, swap elemental builds, and fine-tune your setup however you like.
No fixed meta. No single "right" answer. Just true variety and real flexibility, and plenty of room to experiment.
Keep it casual, or go full theorycraft mode. How deep you go is completely up to you.
[Progress Without the Grind] 
Power up without the endless farming. Even while you're offline, resources stack up, characters grow stronger, and progression keeps moving.
Lie back, rest up, and wake up stronger! Watch clouds drift across the Floating Islands, stargaze from your cozy cabin, hunt for hidden treasure, or level up while doing absolutely nothing heroic for a minute.
Easy progress, low stress, steady rewards—that's what we call relaxed, efficient progression
[Auto-Battles Are Easy, But Never Boring] 
Tired of idle games where heroes just stand still? Here, AI-driven characters adapt to the battlefield—repositioning, predicting enemies, chasing targets, and unleashing ultimate skills. Auto-battles aren’t boring—they’re tactical, flashy, and full of epic combos.
[Unique avatars, without looking the same] 
Your avatar is yours, full stop. Go bold with wild hairstyles, unusual features, standout looks, or choices that are a little chaotic in the best way. Make something cool, weird, stylish, hilarious—or all four at once! No "same face, different outfit." Make it 100% original. Walk into town and stand out. In Kanstein, being unforgettable is part of the fun.

description:
We are the official partner of the German Skat-Association!

Skat is a traditional German card game. It is a 3-player trick-taking game that combines fun, skill and strategy. It is played with a 32 card deck. Each player is dealt 10 cards and the remaining 2 cards form the “skat”. A round is won when one player reaches 61 points or more.

With our game you can compete against players from around the world! The app has been designed by Skat-lovers with the customer in mind and is therefore intuitive and easy to use - turning you into a Skat master in no time!

The best features at a glance:
♣  LIVE WITH REAL PLAYERS: this keeps the game exciting and interesting
♣  FAIRNESS: Cards are dealt randomly using a random number generator (RNG) that is widely recognized and used by many applications. This ensures a fair gaming experience, where your skill at the game makes all the difference.
♣  CHOOSE FROM THREE DIFFERENT CARD DESIGNS: German, French or Tournament card deck
♣  PLAY WITH TOURNAMENT- OR CASUAL RULES: both variants have their charms - just try them out
♣  FLAUNT YOUR SKILLS IN THE LEAGUE: rise up the ranks in our leagues and become a champion
♣  SUPPORT: our intuitive and easy to navigate app, various help sites and a great customer support will facilitate your journey to becoming a Skat master!

If you are a fan of other card games like Doppelkopf, Rummy or Solitaire then you will love Skat! Our game is and will remain entirely free to play, you may however benefit from in-app purchases to enhance your gameplay experience!

Let’s go - Download our app today and enjoy a thrilling new card game experience!
Your Skat Treff Team

name: Butcher Hero: Monster Idle RPG
summary: Hook monsters in the sand, earn XP, upgrade gear and grow in an idle action RPG.
description:
Enter Butcher Hero, an idle action RPG where every enemy becomes fuel for your next upgrade. Explore hostile sand zones, throw your chain hook, pull monsters and aliens into range, earn XP, and devour their power to build a stronger hero.

Hook, devour, grow

Aim the hook, drag in your target, and finish the fight. Each hunt earns XP and turns captured power into permanent upgrades for damage, attack speed, armor, or health. Choose what to improve and shape a build that can survive tougher zones.

Build your RPG hero

Collect gear and tune your loadout for the challenge ahead. Combine equipment with permanent stats, unlock new ways to fight, and upgrade your hero as enemies become stronger. Make meaningful build choices and keep leveling up.

If you enjoy RPG games and progression-focused adventure games, every hunt gives you a clear upgrade choice and a stronger build to take into the next fight.

Action and idle progression

Butcher Hero combines the quick decisions of action games with the steady growth of idle games. Fans of incremental games can start a short hunt, improve permanent stats, and push into a harder zone. Every choice moves your build forward.

Keep building your hero with AFK progression, or use auto-battle when you want a lighter session. Return to choose upgrades, tune your gear, and decide how to tackle the next fight.

Monster survival in the sand

Push through sand-covered areas filled with creatures, elite enemies, and dangerous aliens. Fans of survival games can focus on armor and health, while aggressive builds lean into damage and speed. Adapt your loadout and keep moving as every area raises the pressure.

Win boss battles

Face massive bosses with distinct attacks and rising difficulty. Learn each encounter, improve your gear, and return stronger. Climb the Boss Tower to see how far your build can go and earn rewards from demanding boss battles.

Complete quests and claim rewards

Finish quests, gather crystals, and open chests for resources that help your hero grow. Develop the Soul Graph, reinforce your favorite stats, and create a loadout ready for the next challenge.

Play offline or enter PvP

Fans of offline games can play the complete single-player adventure without an internet connection. When connected, test your build against other heroes in PvP battles. PvP is separate from offline single-player play.

✅ Keep your eBike up to date with updates and make use of the latest functions.
✅ Theft protection: Give your eBike additional protection with eBike Lock and eBike Alarm.
✅ Navigation: Use your phone, Kiox 300 or Kiox 500 for navigation.
✅ Route planning: Plan your route in detail or import it from komoot or Strava.
✅ Activity tracking: Track and analyse your riding and fitness data.
✅ Display configuration: Customise the screen layout of Kiox 300, Kiox 500 and Purion 200.
✅ Custom riding modes: Choose from all the riding modes available for your eBike – and customise them in the usual way.
✅ Help Center: Get quick help with questions about your eBike.

Please note: The eBike Flow app is only compatible with eBikes with the Bosch smart system.

All the information at a glance
The eBike Flow app gives you a clear overview of all the information about your eBike, such as the distance travelled, current battery status or the next service appointment. This way, you always have an overview and can enjoy your next ride.

Theft protection with eBike Lock and eBike Alarm
eBike Lock and eBike Alarm are the ideal complement to the mechanical lock: eBike Lock is your free additional theft protection. Lock and unlock your eBike automatically using your phone or display as a digital key. Protect your eBike even better with the eBike Alarm premium service: with GPS tracking, notifications and alarm signals on the eBike.

Always up to date with updates over-the-air
Updates ensure that your eBike is always up to date and gets even better. You can simply download new eBike functions and transfer them to your eBike via Bluetooth.

route planning
With the eBike Flow app, you can plan your next Tour to perfection: customise the route with map details and a route profile to suit your needs – or import existing routes from komoot or via GPX.

Navigation with phone or display
Navigate with your display or use your phone on the handlebar. No matter what you’re riding with, you have all the important riding data at a glance and can conveniently control and stop the navigation via your control unit.

Activity tracking
The eBike Flow app records your riding data as soon as you set off. In the statistics, you will find valuable insights into your tour and fitness data – to analyse and share, synchronised with Strava.

Riding modes perfectly customised to you.
With the eBike Flow app, you can customise the riding modes to suit you perfectly. Adapt the support, dynamics, maximum torque and maximum speed to your requirements.

Display configuration
Customise the screen layout of your Kiox 300, Kiox 500 or Purion 200 to suit your preferences. With over 30 customisation options, you decide for yourself what you see on your display while riding.

Fast support with the Help Center
Do you have a question about your eBike? Get the answer from our Help Center. Find explanations about functions and components. If you have any problems, you can contact our support team.

name: Minecraft: Dream it, Build it!
summary: Millions of crafters have smashed billions of blocks! Now you can join the fun!
description:
Dive into an open world of building, crafting, and survival in the ultimate sandbox adventure. Gather resources, survive the night, and build a world one block at a time. Explore and craft your way through a completely open world where you can play with friends, new and old. Build a block city, start a farm, mine deep underground, face mysterious enemies, or just experiment to the limits of your imagination in this expansive simulation!
 
Craft a new house, build a block city, or start a farm. Bring your imagination to life and build your dream avatar world where the possibilities are endless. Adventure through your own online game and play with friends, building from the ground up in our crafting simulation. In Creative mode, enjoy unlimited resources and the freedom of superior building and crafting. In Survival mode, survive the night, face intense battles, craft tools, and fend off danger. With seamless cross-platform and multiplayer games with friends on Minecraft: Bedrock Edition, you can adventure solo or with friends and discover an infinite, randomly generated game 3D world filled with blocks to mine, biomes to explore, and mobs to befriend (or battle) in a universe of crafting!
 
In Minecraft, the world is yours to shape!
 
BUILD YOUR DREAM WORLD
• Build a block city, a house, or create an entire game world from the ground up
• Building simulator games for kids, adults, or anyone
• Craft and build from special resources and tools to create brand new structures and landscapes
• Explore an endless open world simulation full of different biomes and creatures
• Minecraft Marketplace – Get creator-made add-ons, thrilling worlds, and stylish cosmetics on Minecraft Marketplace
• Private and community servers – Online village building game allows you to connect with millions of players, or subscribe to Realms Plus to cross-play with up to 10 friends on your own private server
• Slash commands – Tweak how the 3D game plays: you can change the weather, summon mobs, change the time of day, and more
• Add-ons – Block builders can customize their experience even further with add-ons as they build up! If you're more tech-inclined, you can modify your 3D game to create new resource packs
 
 
MULTIPLAYER ONLINE GAMES
• Play with friends and other builders when you join our free massive multiplayer servers
• Multiplayer game servers allow you to play with up to 4 players online with a free Xbox Live account
• Explore endless realms through multiplayer games with friends. With Realms and Realms Plus, you can play with up to 10 friends cross-platform, anytime, anywhere on Realms, your own private server that we host for you
• Customize your world with Realms Plus. Get instant access to an extensive catalogue that is refreshed every month! Share with friends on your own private Realms server*
• MMO servers allow you to connect and play with players across the world, to explore custom worlds, build with friends, and participate in large-scale events
• Enjoy crafting buildings, building gigantic community-run worlds, competing in unique mini-games, and socializing in lobbies full of fellow Minecraft block builders
 
SUPPORT: https://www.minecraft.net/help
LEARN MORE: https://www.minecraft.net/
 
MINIMUM RECOMMENDED SPECIFICATION
To check the requirements for your device visit: https://help.minecraft.net/hc/en-us/articles/4409172223501
 
*Realms & Realms Plus: Try a free 30-day trial in-app.

This app uses Accessibility services.
Minecraft includes an Accessibility Service that improves touch interaction when using a screen reader. This service only adjusts touch-passthrough regions — it does not read, log, or transmit your screen content or personal data.

name: Geometry Dash
summary: Jump and fly your way through danger in this rythm-based action platformer!
description:
Jump and fly your way through danger in this rhythm-based action platformer!

Prepare for a near impossible challenge in the world of Geometry Dash. Push your skills to the limit as you jump, fly and flip your way through dangerous passages and spiky obstacles.

Simple one touch game play with lots of levels that will keep you entertained for hours!

Game Features

• Rhythm-based Action Platforming!
• Lots of levels with unique soundtracks!
• Build and share your own levels using the level editor!
• Unlock new icons and colors to customize your character!
• Fly rockets, flip gravity and much more!
• Use practice mode to sharpen your skills!
• Lots of achievements and rewards!
• No in-app purchases!
• Challenge yourself with the near impossible!

Contact: support@robtopgames.com

name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
summary: Epic fantasy tower defense, return to Linirea and rewrite the kingdom's past
description:
Welcome to Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis, the latest chapter in the legendary tower defense saga. Travel back to the dawn of Linirea, command epic heroes, and stop a young Vez'nan before the kingdom falls, on a battlefield where every tower placement matters.

Build, upgrade, and outwit waves of goblins, orcs, and worse across the original Kingdom Rush lands. Offline. Pure tower defense.
History is broken. The Kingdom has fallen. And the only way to save the future is to defend the past.

A PREQUEL WITH STAKES
Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and uncover the moment that turned a young mage into the saga's greatest villain.

15 TOWERS, ENDLESS STRATEGIES
Archers, mages, barracks, artillery, every tower has a specialty, and the real game is the synergy between them.  Build your defense, lock the lane, watch the wave break. Classic tower defense, refined.

12 LEGENDARY HEROES
Take two heroes into each battle and combine their abilities. Familiar Linirean champions return to your side, fighting beside you like the old days, and a few faces you're about to meet for the first time.

9 POWERFUL SPELLS
Equip a loadout of spells and unleash them at the moment that matters, meteor showers, powerful reinforcements, battlefield-wide control. Save them for the bosses. You'll need them!

18 HANDCRAFTED CAMPAIGN STAGES
Cross three landscapes of early Linirea, from the Citadel to the Stormcloud Depths and the far away lands of Arcania. Face 40+ enemies across 5 distinct races, and 6 colossal bosses standing between you and the future.

THE PLOT THICKENS 
More lore, more callbacks, and the Kingdom Rush humor that made you fall in love with Linirea in the first place.

GAME MODES, ACHIEVEMENTS, AND EASTER EGGS
For the ones who like to 100% everything: 50+ achievements, harder modes if you're feeling brave, and easter eggs we had way too much fun hiding.

OFFLINE, ANYWHERE
Defend the realm on the bus, on a plane, in a tower of your own. No connection required.
Defend the past to change the future. Join the millions of players who have rallied to Linirea since 2011.

name: Scritchy Scratchy
summary: Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots.
description:
Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game where luck is your weapon, and glittering riches are just a scratch away.

Dive into a growing collection of scratchers, each with its own quirks, surprises, and sometimes downsides. Rip through tickets, uncover rare symbols, tweak your own luck, and chase absurd payouts.

Unlock Scratch Bot, your tireless mechanical friend who scratches and reveals the rewards for you. Turn your run into a full-blown jackpot engine as your balance shoots through the roof while you sit back and relax.

As you prosper, you’ll unlock upgrades that twist luck in your favor:
• Boosted odds and payouts
• Faster and easier scratching 
• New scratch card variants with unique rules

But power always comes with risk. Some cards tempt you with monstrous payouts at the cost of nasty penalties. Some offer steady income… others threaten your entire run. Will you play like a sensible adult or gamble like a degenerate in a neon casino?

When you’re ready for even more madness, Prestige to reset your run, gather Jack Points, and spend them on permanent upgrades that reshape your strategy. Build your own luck engine: Slow and steady, wildly explosive, or pure chaos.

Scritchy Scratchy is a dangerously satisfying progression casino, where every scratch is a little dopamine hit, and every run is one lucky break away from the big jackpot!

name: Bloons TD 6
summary: Smash Hit Tower Defense Game
description:
Craft your perfect defense from a combination of powerful Monkey Towers and awesome Heroes, then pop every last invading Bloon!

Over a decade of tower defense pedigree and regular massive updates makes Bloons TD 6 a favorite game for millions of players. Enjoy endless hours of strategy gaming with Bloons TD 6!

HUGE CONTENT!
* Regular updates! We release several updates every year with new characters, features, and gameplay.
* Boss Events! Fearsome Boss Bloons will challenge even the strongest defenses.
* Odysseys! Battle through a series of maps connected by their theme, rules, and rewards.
* Contested Territory! Join forces with other players and battle for territory against five other teams. Capture tiles on a shared map and compete on the leaderboards.
* Quests! Delve into what makes the Monkeys tick with Quests, crafted to tell tales and share knowledge.
* Trophy Store! Earn Trophies to unlock dozens of cosmetic items that let you customize your Monkeys, Bloons, animations, music, and more.
* Content Browser! Create your own Challenges and Odysseys, then share them with other players and check out the most liked and played community content.

EPIC MONKEY TOWERS & HEROES!
* 25 powerful Monkey Towers, each with 3 upgrade paths and unique activated abilities.
* Paragons! Explore the incredible power of the newest Paragon upgrades.
* 17 diverse Heroes, with 20 signature upgrades and 2 special abilities. Plus, unlockable skins and voiceovers!

ENDLESS AWESOMENESS!
* 4-Player Co-Op! Play every map and mode with up to 3 other players in public or private games.
* Play anywhere - single player offline works even when your WiFi doesn’t!
* 70+ handcrafted maps, with more added every update.
* Monkey Knowledge! Over 100 meta-upgrades to add power where you need it.
* Powers and Insta Monkeys! Earned through gameplay, events, and achievements. Instantly add power for tricky maps and modes.

We pack as much content and polish into each update as possible, and we’ll continue to add new features, content, and challenges in regular updates.

We truly respect your time and support, and we hope Bloons TD 6 will be the best strategy game you’ve ever played. If it’s not, please contact us at https://support.ninjakiwi.com and tell us what we can do better!

Now those Bloons aren't going to pop themselves... sharpen your darts and go play Bloons TD 6!


**********

https://ninjakiwi.com/privacy_policy

Your purchases fund our development updates and new games, and we sincerely appreciate every vote of confidence you give us with your purchases. 

Ninja Kiwi Community:
We love hearing from our players, so please get in touch with any feedback, positive or negative, at https://support.ninjakiwi.com.

Streamers and Video Creators: 
Ninja Kiwi is actively promoting channel creators on YouTube and Twitch! If you are not already working with us, keep making videos and tell us about your channel at streamers@ninjakiwi.com.

name: Stardew Valley
summary: The smash hit farming RPG now on mobile!
description:
Stardew Valley comes to Mobile!

Move to the countryside, and cultivate a new life in this award-winning open-ended farming RPG! With over 50+ hours of gameplay content and new Mobile-specific features, such as auto-save and multiple controls options.

**Winner of the Golden Joysticks' Breakthrough Award**
**Nominee of Game of the Year 2017 - BAFTA Games Awards**

---

BUILD THE FARM OF YOUR DREAMS:

■ Turn your overgrown fields into a lively and bountiful farm

■ Raise and breed happy animals, grow a variety of seasonal crops and design your farm, your way

■ Customize your farmer and home! With hundreds of options to choose from

■ Settle down and start a family with 12 potential marriage candidates

■ Become part of the community by taking part in seasonal festivals and villager quests

■ Explore vast, mysterious caves, encountering dangerous monsters and valuable treasure

■ Spend a relaxing afternoon at one of the local fishing spots or go crabbing by the seaside

■ Forage, grow crops and produce artisan goods to cook up as a delicious meal

■ Rebuilt for touch-screen gameplay on Android with mobile-specific features, such as auto-select to toggle quickly between your farming tools and auto-attack to swiftly take down fiendish monsters in the mines

■ Newly Updated Single Player Content - Including new town upgrades, dating events, crops, fishing ponds, hats, clothing, and new pets! Plus more to be discovered...

■ Play the game your way with multiple controls options, such as touch-screen, virtual joystick, and external controller support.

---

"Stardew Valley beautifully combines farm simulation with RPG elements to create an intriguing, absorbing rural world." - IGN

“Far more than just a farming game... filled with seemingly endless content and heart.” Giant Bomb

“Stardew Valley has been the most rich and heartwarming experience I’ve had in a game in years.” CG Magazine

---

Note: Features 1.4 update story content, multiplayer functionality not supported. No in-app purchases.

name: Batomon Showdown
summary: Creature-collecting Strategy Auto Battler
description:
Creature-collecting Strategy Auto Battler with 100+ Batomons and Endless Fun!
Assemble Batomon squad and discover game-breaking combinations and synergies!
【Assemble the Ultimate Team】
Build a team through endless combinations of Batomon, trainers, encounters, trinkets and items. Take advantage of synergies and combos of Batomon that break the game and become overpowered. Battle and defeat other players on your road to become a champion.
【Choose Your Trainer】
Master a diverse lineup of trainers, each bringing a game-changing abilities to the field. From eccentric bug-catchers and dragon-whisperers to chefs who can cook new types onto of your Batomon, every trainer offers a fresh path to becoming a champion.
【Level up your Batomon】
Every Batomon holds infinite potential. Through a deep system of unique abilities, trinkets, and items, you can push your team beyond their limits. Theorycraft your way to victory, as any Batomon can become a powerhouse capable of shattering the meta.
【Battle Other Players】
Every battle is a new discovery. Dive into asynchronous multiplayer to face a near-infinite variety of player-made teams. Play at your own relaxed paced with no timers to rush your decisions. Build the ultimate team to let the world try to break it.

name: Slay the Spire
summary: Deckbuilding Dungeon Crawl
description:
We fused card games and roguelikes together to make the best single player deckbuilder we could. Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics of immense power, and Slay the Spire!

Features
- Dynamic Deck Building: Choose your cards wisely! Discover hundreds of cards to add to your deck with each attempt at climbing the Spire. Select cards that work together to efficiently dispatch foes and reach the top.
- An Ever-changing Spire: Whenever you embark on a journey up the Spire, the layout differs each time. Choose a risky or safe path, face different enemies, choose different cards, discover different relics, and even fight different bosses!
- Powerful Relics to Discover: Powerful items known as relics can be found throughout the Spire. The effects of these relics can greatly enhance your deck through powerful interactions. But beware, obtaining a relic may cost you more than just gold.

name: Wobbly Life
summary: Experience the chaos playing this fun, physics-based open-world multiplayer game
description:
Grandma has kicked you out into the big wide Wobbly World demanding you go and GET A JOB! She would be so proud if you could earn some money and get your own house one day!  

Wobbly Life is a physics-based open-world multiplayer sandbox game where you can explore, complete jobs, earn money, drive vehicles, own houses, collect pets and embark on hilarious adventures together. 

Play with all of your friends across ANY mobile platform and explore a vibrant world packed with secrets, missions, mini-games, vehicles and surprises. If you enjoy family-friendly sandbox games, multiplayer adventures, life simulation games and open-world exploration, you’ll love Wobbly Life. 

🌎 EXPLORE A HUGE OPEN WORLD 
• Explore towns, mountains, islands, caves and hidden locations 
• Complete story missions to unlock unique rewards 
• Solve mysteries and uncover secrets across Wobbly Island 
• Train to become a Wobbly Astronaut and launch into space 

Almost everything in Wobbly Life is interactive, creating endless opportunities for exploration, experimentation and fun. 

💰COMPLETE JOBS & EARN MONEY 
Grandma wants you to get a job! Choose from 20+ unique jobs and earn money to unlock new content. Every job offers unique challenges, rewards and opportunities to build your Wobbly fortune. 

🏠CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER, HOUSE & VEHICLES 
 Spend your hard-earned money on exciting upgrades and unlockables. 
• Choose from 500+ clothing items 
• Collect and care for pets 
• Purchase houses ranging from small cabins to luxury mansions 
• Unlock and drive 90+ vehicles 
• Personalize your Wobbly character and lifestyle 

🎢CHALLENGE FRIENDS & CLIMB LEADERBOARDS 
Compete against players around the world or challenge friends directly to see who can earn the highest scores, complete the most jobs and set the fastest race times. Choose from the Richest Wobbler, Job Master, Race King and Wobble Run Champion leaderboard, all available in the Google Play Games leaderboard. 

 😶 JOIN OUR WOBBLY COMMUNITY 
Join us on Discord and check out the amazing Wobbly community! 

Download Wobbly Life today and discover one of the most fun, creative and adventure-filled multiplayer sandbox games available.

name: Balatro
summary: When Poker Meets Solitaire
description:
Welcome to the official Balatro game!

Your goal is to beat Boss Blinds by making strong poker hands. 
Find new Jokers that change the game and create awesome and exciting combos! Take on challenging bosses, discover wild poker hands and unlock new decks as you play. 

You’ll need all the help you can get to beat the big boss, win the final challenge, and win the game.

Features:

* Remastered controls for touch screen devices; now even more satisfying!
* Each run is different: every pick-up, discard and joker can dramatically alter the course of your run.
* Multiple game items: discover over 150 Jokers, each with special powers. Use them with different decks,upgrade cards and vouchers to boost your scores.
* Different Game modes: Campaign mode and challenge mode for you to play.
* Beautiful Pixel Art: Immerse yourself in the CRT fuzz and enjoy detailed, hand-crafted pixel art.

name: Drop Duchy
summary: Build your duchy piece by piece in this refreshing hybrid rogue-lite game!
description:
[TRY BEFORE YOU BUY!] A beloved PC game, now coming to mobile.

Metacritic: 83. Very Positive on STEAM - 90%.

Drop Duchy takes the iconic geometric puzzle gameplay we all know and love and gives it a fresh perspective: instead of simply clearing lines, you build a realm. A mix of deckbuilding, puzzle and rogue-lite, designed to hone your appetite as a block-stacking tactician.

Place tile pieces as you would in a block-dropping game, but align them to maximize their activation rules. Set the right structures next to lush forests, wild rivers and grassy plains to pull out maximum resources and units.

Then gather your troops, reclaim the regions under enemy control, and storm the enemy fortress along branching, decision-filled paths. Let your castle take too much damage and the run ends - but defeat is not the end: jump straight back in with a new strategy, and use the experience gained to unlock even more content.

Grow in power with over 110 unique cards, trade with markets and guilds, and climb a meta progression of over 90 missions tied to three playable factions: The Duchy, The Order and The Republic.

Adapt, conquer, and keep the action moving!

FEATURES

* An original mix of puzzle gameplay and real-time strategy
* A brand new game experience with each run thanks to procedural generation
* Play with Factions: The Duchy, The Order, The Republic
* Meta progression: over 90 challenges designed to help you through your journey
* Build the perfect deck with over 110 unique cards
* An elegant and charming art direction to please your eyes
* An engaging and ever-evolving soundtrack to please your ears
* Choose your path between lakes, glades, forests, villages, guilds… and more!

name: Farming Simulator 26 Mobile
summary: Rise to the Challenge of Farming!
description:
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be! Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and other machines. Start logging with heavy forestry equipment, or tend to adorable farm animals like cows, sheep, chickens, goats, and their offspring.

• Tons of possibilities on two new maps
• 15 different field crops, plus trees
• 120+ authentic, GPS-enabled machines
• Farm challenges that keep you on your toes
• Production chains, logistics, and more

Operate more than 120 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world.

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry, there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life.

name: Winter Burrow
summary: Survive the wilderness to restore your childhood home in this cozy crafting sim
description:
Winter Burrow is a cozy woodland survival game. Explore, gather resources, craft tools, knit warm sweaters, bake pies and meet the locals!

In Winter Burrow, you play a mouse who returns from the big city to find their childhood home in ruins. To make matters worse, your Aunt (who was supposed to be looking after it) has gone missing. Restore your broken-down childhood burrow to its former glory so you can relax in front of the fireplace.

Brave the elements and journey out into the frozen wilderness to collect vital resources for both yourself and your new home. Beware of the insect wildlife and remember that nobody survives on their own; find new friends, expand your survival handbook and solve the mystery of what happened to your Aunt.

Winter Burrow is a survival game you play at your own pace. Customize your character, decorate your burrow and choose a path that fits your play style. This story is yours to tell.

name: Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot
summary: Lead your own dwarf legion in an auto-battle roguelike of glory, death & loot.
description:
Command a fearless band of dwarves in a roguelike auto-battler filled with chaos, strategy, and loot. Every run challenges your tactics as you recruit, equip, and position your squad against waves of enemies that grow stronger with every battle. Glory, death, and loot await those who dare to lead.

Build your legion of dwarves
Recruit and customize up to ten unique dwarves, each with their own class, stats, and abilities. Create powerful synergies by mixing tanks, assassins, healers, and mages. Every item and formation choice can decide victory or defeat.

Strategize before the battle begins
Your dwarves fight automatically, but the outcome depends on your preparation. Arrange your formation, manage your resources, and pick upgrades that complement your team’s strengths. The right setup is the difference between triumph and a total wipeout.

Gather gear and legendary loot
Collect weapons, armor, and accessories after every encounter. Upgrade your heroes, craft new builds, and experiment with combinations to discover deadly strategies.

Master the roguelike loop
Each run is a fresh challenge. Choose your rewards, face unpredictable enemies, and push deeper for greater treasures. Even failure brings progress as you unlock new dwarves, skills, and permanent upgrades.

Face growing threats
Battle orcs, trolls, dragons, and countless monsters across varied stages. Adapt to enemy types and evolve your strategy with each run.

Easy to play, hard to master
With one-tap controls and endless strategic depth, Dwarves: Glory, Death and Loot is a game for players who love tactical thinking, build experimentation, and the thrill of progression.

Lead your dwarves to glory, embrace the chaos, and claim your loot.

name: MONOPOLY
summary: Roll the dice, pass go and win! Play Hasbro's official MONOPOLY mobile game.
description:
Play MONOPOLY on the go without distractions – no ads, no fuss! 

Challenge friends, family and fans from around the globe in the digital version of the official MONOPOLY board game, licensed by Hasbro. 

Head online to play your favourite board game with anyone, anywhere, at any time, or compete against state-of-the-art AI opponents offline. Plus, with the seamless PASS & PLAY mode, you can play the classic MONOPOLY board game with your friends with just one device! 

The classic MONOPOLY board game takes a bold leap into a new format, arriving on mobile with amazing graphics, smooth animations and a catchy soundtrack! 


HOW TO PLAY MONOPOLY

1. Download the official MONOPOLY app
2. Press “PLAY”
3. Pick a mode, board, dice and token
4. Roll the dice and move around the board
5. If you land on a property tile, you can buy it
6. Collect rent when other players land on it
7. Continue around the board, drawing cards when instructed – will you be hit with a surprise tax? Sent to jail? Or get a little bonus money? 
8. If you run out of money, you’ll be bankrupt and out of the game
9. The last player left with a profit wins! 

FEATURES

- MONOPOLY ON THE GO – No connection? No problem. Our roster of AI opponents are ready to challenge you! Or play with your friends offline with Pass & Play! 
- MULTIPLE MODES – Take on AI opponents in Single Player or compete against friends and family in Pass & Play or Online With Friends. Try out Online Multiplayer and face off against fellow tycoons from around the world! 
- EXCLUSIVE BOARDS – Experience the iconic board game like never before with exclusive boards and more! 
- AWESOME NEW TOKENS AND DICE – Whatever your style, MONOPOLY has a set of dice fit for a future tycoon! Pick from nostalgic classic tokens or brand-new designs exclusive to the mobile game.

Get the most authentic MONOPOLY experience with the official MONOPOLY mobile game!

name: Mini Metro
summary: Design a subway map for a growing city.
description:
Mini Metro, the sublime subway simulator, now on Android. No ads or in-app purchases.

• 2016 BAFTA nominee
• 2016 IGF award winner
• 2016 IGN Mobile Game of the Year finalist
• 2016 Gamespot's Best Mobile Game selection

Mini Metro is a game about designing a subway map for a growing city. Draw lines between stations and start your trains running. As new stations open, redraw your lines to keep them efficient. Decide where to use your limited resources. How long can you keep the city moving?

• Random city growth means each game is unique.
• Over two dozen of real-world cities to test your planning skills.
• A variety of upgrades so you can tailor your network.
• Normal mode for quick scored games, Endless to relax, or Extreme for the ultimate challenge.
• Build your metro exactly how you want to with the all-new Creative mode.
• Compete against the world every day in the Daily Challenge.
• Colorblind and night modes.
• Responsive soundtrack created by your metro system, engineered by Disasterpeace.

Please note that Mini Metro is incompatible with some Bluetooth headphones. If you do not hear audio over Bluetooth, please try disconnecting your headphones and restarting the game.

name: DAVE THE DIVER
summary: Dive by Day, Serve by Night!
description:
Dive by Day, Serve by Night!

[An adventure, RPG, management hybrid]
Explore and unravel the mysteries in the depths of the Blue Hole by day and run a successful exotic sushi restaurant by night.
It's easy to get hooked on the satisfying gameplay loop!

[Casual combat and gathering gameplay with rogue-like elements]
Dive into the ever-changing Blue Hole and use a harpoon and other weapons to catch fish and various creatures.
Upgrade and forge equipment with collected resources and sushi restaurant profits to prepare for the dangers that lurk in the unknown.
Running out of oxygen means leaving collected items and fish behind!

[Eccentric characters with a lighthearted narrative]
Quirky but lovable characters and a story full of in-jokes, spoofs, and other humorous scenes provide an approachable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

[A beautiful sea environment with attractive 2D/3D Art]
A combination of pixel and 3D graphics provides a stunning art style that showcases breathtaking underwater scenery.
This oceanic adventure is set in the real marine environment of a Blue Hole filled with over 200 kinds of sea creatures.

[Ample additional content to complement the main gameplay loop]
Minigames, side quests, and multiple storylines provide many hours of entertainment and varied gameplay.

[Supported Devices]
Minimum: Android 8.0 or higher / 6GB RAM / Snapdragon 680 or equivalent processor
Recommended: Android 8.0 or higher / 8GB RAM / Snapdragon 730G or equivalent processor

name: Sea of Stars
summary: A journey of peril and wonder
description:
Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.

FEATURES
- Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
- Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games.
- A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production.
- A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience.

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Google Play Games achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between Android devices
- Compatible with controllers

name: Brotato: Premium
summary: 🥔 Survive the alien horde! Equip 6 weapons at once in this roguelite shooter.
description:
Blast through alien hordes as Brotato, the only potato capable of wielding 6 weapons simultaneously! 

You are the last hope on a hostile planet. Stranded and outnumbered, you must battle relentless waves of aliens, scavenge materials, and craft unique builds to survive until rescue arrives. Can you hold out against the endless swarm?

Each run lasts just 20–30 minutes, delivering thrilling, fast-paced roguelite action perfect for quick mobile sessions. Build your strategy with dozens of traits and hundreds of items—and see how far you can survive!

【KEY FEATURES】
⚔️ SIX-WEAPON FRENZY: Wield up to 6 weapons at once with default auto-firing or precision manual aiming.
⏱️ FAST-PACED ACTION: Quick, intense runs designed to be completed in under 30 minutes.
🎭 DIVERSE CHARACTERS: Choose from a wide range of traits—from One-Armed and Crazy to Lucky and Mage—to create your unique build.
🛠️ INFINITE BUILDS: Experiment with hundreds of items and weapons, including flamethrowers, SMGs, rocket launchers, and even sticks & stones!
🌊 SURVIVAL WAVES: Survive 20 to 90-second waves and collect materials to level up and gear up in the shop.

⚠️ NOTE: Cloud saving is available only while online. You can play offline, but your progress will not be synced to the cloud without an internet connection.

【STAY CONNECTED】

💬 Discord: @Erabit or join via https://discord.gg/P6vekfhc46

name: TABS Pocket Edition
summary: Be the leader of wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places, and fantasy worlds.
description:
Be the leader of red and blue wobblers from ancient lands, spooky places and fantasy worlds. Watch them fight in simulations made with the wobbliest physics system ever created. 

When you grow tired of the 100+ wobblers at your disposal you can make new ones in the unit creator.

You can also send your wobblers to fight your friends or strangers in online multiplayer!

Features:

    -Campaigns
    -Multiplayer
    -Sandbox mode
    -Unit Possession
    -A bunch of silly units

Please note that the game involves a significant amount of real-time 3D rendering, which can be demanding on device performance.

Minimum recommended Android devices:
Devices with more than 6 GB of RAM and a chipset equivalent to or better than the Snapdragon 778.

Recommended Android specs:
Devices with more than 8 GB of RAM and a chipset equivalent to or better than the Kirin 9000.

Additionally, the game uses an online server to sync and save progress, so a network connection is required.

name: RFS - Real Flight Simulator
summary: Fly around the world! Pilot 3D airplanes and land at airports in this live sim!
description:
Your Ultimate Flight Simulation Experience on Mobile! Discover the thrill of aviation with RFS - Real Flight Simulator, the most advanced flight simulation for mobile.

Whether you are a pro pilot or starting your journey into airplane games, RFS offers the most comprehensive experience. Pilot iconic aircraft, access global flights in real time, and explore ultra-realistic airports with live weather. This is the ultimate simulator for fans of plane games and flight simulation games.

Fly Anywhere in the World!
Take off from any part of the globe. Our flight simulator uses high-res satellite maps and 3D plane models to create a living world. Experience the unique sensation of being an airplane pilot as you navigate realistic topography. Fly through the world and explore detailed landmarks in your favorite 3D airplane.

60+ Aircraft Models – Take control of commercial, cargo, and military jets. From narrow-body airliners to massive jumbo planes, each aircraft features 3D live cockpits, FMC, and realistic lighting. New airplanes and planes are added regularly to our fleet!

1900+ HD Airports – Land your plane at detailed 3D airports with jetways and authentic taxiway procedures. Navigate busy terminals like a real pilot. Ground services include pushback, refueling, and catering for a complete airline experience.

Realistic Satellite Terrain – Fly over high-fidelity landscapes. Our technology provides accurate elevation data for every mountain and valley. Experience the most advanced landing simulator on mobile. Perfect for fans of realistic flight simulator gameplay.

Autopilot & Advanced Planning – Plan long-haul flights with precise autopilot, VNAV, LNAV, and ILS landing assistance. Customize weather, system failures, and navigation routes. Share flight plans with other pilots and explore the global aviation network.

Real Pilot Checklists – Master every stage of the flight. Follow authentic takeoff and landing procedures for total immersion in your pilot simulator. Use real-world protocols for every flight and plane mission.

Live Global Flights – Experience the world in real-time! Track over 40,000 real-time flights daily at major hubs world-wide. See live air traffic and join a living global flight network.

Join a Global Aviation Community!
RFS is more than just a flight game; it’s a living community.

• Fly with hundreds of aviators in real-time multiplayer modes.
• Chat with fellow pilots in the cockpit or global frequency.
• Join a Virtual Airline (VA) and compete in the leaderboards.

ATC Mode: Take Control of the Skies!
Become an Air Traffic Controller! 

• Manage live air traffic in our dedicated ATC game mode.
• Issue instructions, guide planes to the runway, and ensure safe navigation.
• Experience high-fidelity multi-voice ATC communications.

Create and Share Your Passion!

• Customize Your Plane: Design custom airplane liveries and share them globally.
• Design Your Airport: Build your own HD airport and watch the community take off.
• Plane Spotter Mode: Capture 3D screenshots and share with airplane game fans.
• Dynamic Environment: Experience stunning sunrise and sunsets in highest fidelity.

Technical Sim Features:

• Multi-panel instruments for advanced avionics.
• Realistic 3D spatial audio and real-time weather.
• Complex failure simulation including engines and gear.
• Weight and balance for realistic flight physics.

An Internet connection is required for real-time simulation and multiplayer.
Some features and airplanes require a subscription.

Get Ready to Soar!
Buckle up, push the throttle, and become a Real Pilot in RFS!

Support: rfs@rortos.com

name: CloverPit
summary: A rogue-lite slot machine nightmare. Gamble for your life in a debt simulator!
description:
Clover Pit is a demonic rogue-lite that traps players in a hell of their own creation. Locked in a rusty cell with a slot machine and an ATM, you must pay off your debt at the end of each round, or fall to ruin – literally!

Manipulate the slot machine to earn extra coins. Turn the odds in your favor with various prizes and charms that trigger big big combos, snowballing into a dazzling lucky run. Bend the rules, break the game, and pay off your captor long enough to earn a shot at freedom.

Features:
- A gripping rogue-lite where every round could be your last!
- Meta-progression, multiple endings and unlockable power-ups!
- Push your score to new heights in Endless Mode!
- A hellish escape room atmosphere!
- 150 + items and synergies to boost your luck!
- A sinister tale of addiction and escape!

Note on Save Data: This game currently stores progress locally on your device. Please be aware that uninstalling the app (or clearing app data) will delete your save file. Cloud Save & Cross-Device Sync are in development for a future update.

P.S. IS THIS GAMBLING?
No! CloverPit is a rogue-lite horror game, and not a slot machine simulator. Our slot machine is designed to be broken and ultimately overcome, and will never ask you for real money!

name: Root Board Game
summary: A Digital Board Game of Woodland Warfare
description:
Play the digital adaptation of the beloved tabletop board game. Root is a game of adventure and war where 2 to 4 players battle for control of a vast wilderness.

The nefarious Marquise de Cat has seized the great woodland, intent on harvesting its riches. Under her rule, the many creatures of the forest have banded together. This Alliance will seek to strengthen its resources and subvert the rule of Cats. In this effort, the Alliance may enlist the help of the wandering Vagabonds who are able to move through the more dangerous woodland paths. Though some may sympathize with the Alliance’s hopes and dreams, these wanderers are old enough to remember the great birds of prey who once controlled the woods.

Meanwhile, at the edge of the region, the proud, squabbling Eyrie have found a new commander who they hope will lead their faction to resume their ancient birthright.

The stage is set for a contest that will decide the fate of the great woodland. It is up to the players to decide which group will ultimately take root.

name: Servant of the Lake
summary: Servant of the Lake is a point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.
description:
Welcome to the Vanderboom house, home to the infamous Vanderboom family! 
Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately!

Solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your daily tasks, look after the household, welcome the visitor and ensure their comfort while helping the family achieve their alchemical ambitions.

Servant of the Lake is the new premium point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series from the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within and Underground Blossom.

Features:

▪ Going back to our Roots – Servant of the Lake is a classic single-player Rusty Lake point-and-click adventure set in the infamous Vanderboom house during the era of Aldous and William Vanderboom.

▪ Solve surreal puzzles – Expect to go from simple tasks such as straightening the family portraits and doing the laundry to assisting in complex experiments and cleaning up the aftermath.

▪ Unravel a dark narrative – Live through events set decades before Rusty Lake: Roots! As the servant of the Vanderboom estate, you can explore each room of The House while making sure the family is looked after. Do you think you can survive the weekend?

▪ Immersive soundtrack – Haunting melodies composed and performed by Victor Butzelaar to keep you company while puzzling your way through your daily, usual and unusual tasks.

name: The Room
summary: The definitive puzzle experience
description:
Welcome to The Room, a physical puzzler, wrapped in a mystery game, inside a beautifully tactile 3D world.

*****************

How are you, old friend? If you’re reading this, then it worked. I only hope you can still forgive me. 

We’ve never seen eye to eye on my research, but you must put such things behind you. You are the only one to whom I can turn. You must come at once, for we are all in great peril. I trust you remember the house? My study is the highest room. 

Press forward with heart. There is no way back now. 

AS. 

****** 
Fireproof Games are very proud to bring you our greatest creation, a mind-bending journey filled with beauty, peril and mystery in equal measure. Be transported into a unique space that blends spellbinding visuals with intriguing problems to solve.

• Unsettlingly realistic graphics: Vibrant natural-looking visuals perfected for mobile displays.
• Spine-tingling single finger controls: touch controls so natural you can play with one digit, to fully navigate this mysteriously beautiful 3D world.
• Fantastical pick-up-and-play design: Easy to start, hard to put down, the secrets of The Room will immerse you before you even know you're playing.
• Compelling layers of mystery: think you know what you're looking at? Think again.

name: Terraforming Mars
summary: The digital strategy game adaptation of the famous board game.
description:
Touch Arcade : 5/5 ★
Pocket Tactics : 4/5 ★

CREATE LIFE ON MARS

Lead a corporation and launch ambitious Mars terraforming projects. Direct massive construction works, manage and use your resources, create cities, forests and oceans, and set rewards and objectives to win the game!

In Terraforming Mars, place your cards on the board and use them wisely:
- Achieve a high Terraform Rating, by increasing the temperature and oxygen level or creating oceans... Make the planet habitable for future generations!
- Get Victory Points by building cities, infrastructure and other ambitious projects.
- But watch out! Rival corporations will try to slow you down... That's a nice forest you planted there... It'd be a shame if an asteroid crashed right on it.

Will you be able to lead humanity into a new era? The terraforming race begins now!

Features:
•	The official adaptation of Jacob Fryxelius' famous board game.
•	Mars for all: Play against the computer or challenge up to 5 players in multiplayer mode, online or offline.
•	Game variant: Try the rules of the Corporate Era for a more complex game. With the addition of new cards, including 2 new corporations, focused on economy and technology, you will discover one of the most strategic variants of the game!
•	Solo Challenge: Finish terraforming Mars before the end of generation 14. Try new rules and features in the most challenging Solo mode on the (red) planet.

DLCs:
•	Speed up your game with the Prelude expansion, adding a new phase at the start of the game to specialize your corporation and boost your early game. It also introduces new cards, corporations and a new solo challenge.
•	Explore a new side of Mars with the Hellas & Elysium maps, each bringing a new set of twists, awards and milestones. From the Southern Wilds to the Other Face of Mars, the taming of the Red Planet continues.
•	Add the Venus board to your game, with a new Solar phase to hasten your games. Shake up Terraforming Mars with the Morning Star expansion, featuring new cards, corporations, and resources!
•	Spice up the game with 7 new cards from the Original Promo Pack: Includes everything from the microbe-oriented corporation Splice to the game-changing Self-Replication Robot project.

* Try the Big Box Promo Pack and its 23 cards to raise the level even higher. Play as the expert-only Pharmacy Union or enjoy the more relaxed Astrodrill corporation with this DLC!
* Establish outposts and trade with them in Colonies! Featuring 49 project cards, 5 corporations, and a whole new game system, Colonies is the most content-packed DLC to date!

Languages available: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian, Swedish

Find all the latest news for Terraforming Mars on Facebook, Twitter and Youtube!

YouTube: https://www.YouTube.com/c/TwinSailsInteractive

name: Tower Defense Legend 5 Pro
summary: Defend the last base and protect humans against alien monsters !
description:
Defense Legend Version: Tower Defense 5 - premium is the advanced version of free one. At the same time, players will be awarded items as bellow:
- Premium forever
- No Ads all
 Unleash epic tower defense strategies in Defense Legend 5 Pro: Epic TD!  Searching for the ultimate tower defense experience? Look no further.  This premium version of the hit TD game throws you into a futuristic war where Earth's last defenses have crumbled against a relentless Dark force.  As a brilliant commander, you'll lead the charge to protect humanity's new home on a distant planet, deploying cunning tactics against alien monsters invading from the air, jungles, deserts, and even frozen wastelands.


▶ Follow us on:

name: Incredibox
summary: Create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers!
description:
Incredibox lets you create your own music with the help of a merry crew of beatboxers. Choose your musical style to start laying down, recording and sharing your mix. Get your groove on with hip-hop beats, electro waves, pop voices, jazzy swing, Brazilian rhythms and much more. As well, discover a selection of mods created by the community. Plenty to keep you mixing for hours, with no ads or microtransactions.

Part game, part tool, Incredibox is above all an audio and visual experience that has quickly become a hit with people of all ages. The right mix of music, graphics, animation and interactivity makes Incredibox ideal for everyone. And because it makes learning fun and entertaining, Incredibox is now being used by schools all over the world.

How to play? Easy! Drag and drop icons onto the avatars to make them sing and start to compose your own music. Find the right sound combos to unlock animated choruses that will enhance your tune.

Once your composition sounds great, just save it and share it to get as many votes as possible. If you get enough votes, you may go down in Incredibox history by joining the Top 50 chart! Ready to show your stuff?

You can also download your mix as an MP3 from the app and listen to it over and over again!

Too lazy to create your own mix? No problem, just let the automatic mode play for you!

Pump it up and chill ;)

****************
Incredibox, the brainchild of Lyon, France-based studio So Far So Good, was created in 2009. Starting out as a webpage, it was then released as a mobile and tablet app and became an instant hit. It has won several awards and appeared in various international media, including: BBC, Adobe, FWA, Gizmodo, Slate, Konbini, Softonic, Kotaku, Cosmopolitan, PocketGamer, AppAdvice, AppSpy, Vice, Ultralinx and many others. The online demo has attracted more than 100 million visitors since its creation.

name: Farming Simulator 23 Mobile
summary: Grow your agricultural empire with 100+ authentic machines!
description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 

Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!

Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 

There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 

Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.

New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

Farming Simulator 23 will be released on May 23, 2023, and is the latest official game in the successful simulation series available for mobile devices.

name: Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance TD
summary: Protect the Kingdom with your Strategy in this Epic Tower Defense Adventure
description:
The epic tower defense battles you love are back: welcome to Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance!

As a formidable evil emerges over the kingdom, an unexpected alliance is formed: unleash the ultimate tower defense battle to defend the kingdom and the whole realm with the best of both armies!

Though they may journey side by side, the typical brawls of an improvised alliance could swiftly alter the tides of the adventure.

Prepare to harness the formidable might of dual heroes on td battles!
Now, get to handle TWO HEROES at the same time! Clash with dreadful enemies while leading double the action!

Of course, your beloved Kingdom Rush signature epic towers couldn’t be left out of the Alliance: recruit Paladins, Archers, Mages, Necromancers, and even more!

Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance  offers greater action, strategy games, tower defense battles, mighty heroes, and powerful towers than ever before!
And of course, the usual wacky humor our tower defense games are known for. Because what’s an epic clash without a few jokes?
It’s time to defend the kingdom once again!
Get to clash in an epic adventure across incredible terrains, wild td battles, unpredictable challenges, and unexpected threats!

GAME FEATURES:
Recruit 34 unique heroes and towers!

- 18 ELITE TOWERS to build and upgrade
What’s a strategy game without mighty defense towers? Seize them to clash against any enemy!
Pick between accurate Archers, lethal Paladins, and even trickful Demon Pits.

- 16 EPIC HEROES - take tower defense battles to the next level
PLAY WITH 2 HEROES SIMULTANEOUSLY!
Get ready to witness the formidable might of the most unlikely dual-heroes combinations. A forest guardian spirit and a powerful battle automaton or perhaps a space-bending mage and your average Joe.

- 6 TERRAINS with fascinating battlefields to conquer
Defend Kingdom Rush’s colorful landscapes. Clash across the realm’s deep forest, or even its dangerous caverns.

- 25 CAMPAIGN STAGES full of fast-paced td battles
Set your strategy in exotic terrains full of surprising challenges and details.
Clash against hordes of unpredictable enemies and epic boss fights to take your defense strategy to the limit!

- 3 DIFFERENT GAME MODES to test your might
Try different and more challenging ways of playing each stage after you emerge victorious. Who doesn't love a good challenge?

- 58+ GAME ACHIEVEMENTS to conquer in battle
What’s an epic strategy game without tasty rewards? Show off your skills and unlock prizes!

- 45+ DIFFERENT ENEMIES to test your tower defense wits
Show the alliance’s td battle skills with 4 different enemy clans. Beat each of them with a unique defense strategy!

- And, of course…
There are lots of easter eggs and the usual Ironhide Game Studio lighthearted humor.
Because what's a strategy game without a few hidden surprises?

name: Antolin Lesespiele 3/4
summary: With Antolin children can improve their reading skills in a fun way.
description:
With Antolin the reader, children can improve their reading skills in a playful way. Perception and word comprehension as well as meaning-understanding and information-extracting reading are practiced. The child learns to grasp words faster, so that their reading fluency and reading speed increase.
The lovingly designed and fast-paced exercises also offer a lot of action and fun so that reading training takes place on the side! By playing against time, the children are motivated to improve their high score and thus to repeat frequently. Different speeds and levels of difficulty allow every child to start according to their reading ability.

The 8 reading games promote central reading skills:

Chasing points
A rapidly moving point is followed with the eyes, in which another letter or another word appears from time to time. This exercise trains the ability to concentrate as well as smooth and quick eye movement. At the same time, reflexive reactions and gazing leaps are practiced. Because when reading fluently and quickly, the eyes do not move evenly from letter to letter, but rather they jump from one stopping point to the next.

Ghost words
A word is shown which disappears after a short time. This word should be recognized from a selection of four words.
This exercise trains the holistic understanding and recognition of the word form of up to four-syllable words. As a result, the child can grasp words faster, so that his reading fluency increases.

Word pairs
The dissimilar word pairs are to be recognized from a number of word pairs and tapped.
This exercise trains the reading speed of known and unfamiliar words. The words are perceived as images and are not laboriously read letter by letter.

Word grid
The word you are looking for should be found twice in a letter field as quickly as possible.
The words are hidden horizontally and vertically or diagonally and around the corner, depending on the level.
This exercise trains the understanding of words and the discrimination of word images.

Bookworm
The words and phrases you are looking for should be read as quickly as possible in a continuum of moving letters. This exercise trains the recognition of words and word boundaries.

Image search
In a picture, the described situations should be found and tapped as quickly as possible. This exercise trains meaningful and information-extracting reading as well as the ability to relate information (from text and image) to one another, to draw conclusions and to distinguish important from unimportant.

Soap bubbles
This exercise trains the gaze span, concentration and word comprehension. The children's eye must wander over the entire playing field, as the choices are spread over the whole playing field and are constantly moving. With a concentrated look and reading, it must be noticed in a short time whether the scrambled word in the balloon contains the same letters as the search word. Reading skills and abilities are thereby further consolidated and promoted.

Reading puzzle
In so-called logicals, after carefully reading the information, the children assign jobs, characteristics and favorite colors to people, for example.
This exercise trains meaningful and information-extracting reading as well as the ability to relate information (from several texts) to one another, to draw conclusions and to distinguish important from unimportant.

The points that the children achieve in the Antolin Lesepiele app are not added to the points account on www.antolin.de.

summary: Keep an eye on the animatronics and you'll make it thru the night... probably.
description:
NOTE: Remastered version from the PC version. A device with at least 2 GB of RAM is required for this game to run properly.

Welcome to your new summer job at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza, where kids and parents alike come for entertainment and food as far as the eye can see! The main attraction is Freddy Fazbear, of course; and his two friends. They are animatronic robots, programmed to please the crowds! The robots' behavior has become somewhat unpredictable at night however, and it was much cheaper to hire you as a security guard than to find a repairman.

From your small office you must watch the security cameras carefully. You have a very limited amount of electricity that you're allowed to use per night (corporate budget cuts, you know). That means when you run out of power for the night- no more security doors and no more lights! If something isn't right- namely if Freddybear or his friends aren't in their proper places, you must find them on the monitors and protect yourself if needed!

Can you survive five nights at Freddy's?

summary: The Past Within is the co-op experience from Rusty Lake!
description:
Note: The Past Within is a co-op only game. Both players need to own a copy of the game on their own device (mobile, tablet or computer), as well as a way to communicate with each other. Play together with a friend or find a partner on our official Discord server!

The past and future cannot be explored alone! Team up with a friend and piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives! 

The Past Within is the first co-op only point-and-click adventure set in the mysterious world of Rusty Lake.

Features:

▪ A co-op experience 
Play together with a friend, one in The Past, the other in The Future. Work together to solve the puzzles and help Rose set her father’s plan in motion!
▪ Two worlds - Two perspectives 
Both players will experience their environments in two different dimensions: 2D as well as in 3D - a first-time experience in the Rusty Lake universe!
▪ Cross-platform
As long as you can communicate with each other, you and your partner of choice can each play The Past Within on your preferred platform: PC, Mac, iOS, Android and (very soon) Nintendo Switch! 
▪ Playtime & Replayability
The game contains 2 chapters and has an average play-time of 2 hours. For the full experience, we recommend replaying the game from the other perspective. Plus you can use our replayability feature for a fresh start with new solutions to all puzzles.

name: Dice A Million
summary: Have you ever tried to roll 1,000,000 on a set of dice?
description:
Dice A Million is a roguelike deckbuilder about rolling dice to try and get to a million points. That's the whole point. (get it?!)

You're trapped in this dice rolling facility, so let's get rolling and try to escape. Combine the effects of more than 120 different dice and discover powerful synergies. Get through ever-increasing debts and challenging bosses that will require perfect symbiosis in your bag in order to be beaten.

Will you be able to push luck to your side?

description:
In Monument Valley you will manipulate impossible architecture and guide a silent princess through a stunningly beautiful world.

Monument Valley is a surreal exploration through fantastical architecture and impossible geometry. Guide the silent princess Ida through mysterious monuments, uncovering hidden paths, unfolding optical illusions and outsmarting the enigmatic Crow People.

Ida's Dream now available.

"Brilliant design... stayed with me like a dream I didn't want to forget... 9/10" - Polygon

BEAUTIFUL

Synchronize your game across all your devices.

TABLET SUPPORT

Monument Valley is optimised for both tablets and phones.

summary: Kill the monsters & grab the loot in the classic card game!
description:
Kill the monsters! Steal the treasure! Stab your buddy!
In partnership with Steve Jackson Games, the iconic tabletop card game Munchkin brings its murderous mischief to digital devices!

With millions of copies sold around the world, Munchkin is the mega-hit card game about dungeon adventure...with none of that stupid roleplaying stuff. You and your friends compete to kill monsters and grab magic items. Don the Horny Helmet and the Boots of Butt-Kicking. Wield the Staff of Napalm...or maybe the Chainsaw of Bloody Dismemberment. Start by slaughtering the Potted Plant and the Drooling Slime, and work your way up to the Plutonium Dragon!

Build a character by combining Race and Class cards, then gear up to face the lurking monsters!
Kill monsters and collect Treasure to level up! The first Munchkin to reach Level 10 wins!
But wait...there's more!
Cross-platform, online multiplayer shenanigans!
Learn the tricks of the adventuring trade in a dungeon-delving tutorial!
Sharpen your blade in Solo Challenges with special rules!
Go looking for trouble in Munchkin. Hey, we're all going to get roasted and eaten sometime.

name: Papers, Please
summary: A dystopian document thriller.
description:
A dystopian document thriller.
The award-winning, critically-acclaimed border inspector game.

The communist state of Arstotzka has just ended a 6-year war with neighboring Kolechia and reclaimed its rightful half of the border town, Grestin. 

Your job as immigration inspector is to control the flow of people entering the Arstotzkan side of Grestin from Kolechia. Among the throngs of immigrants and visitors looking for work are hidden smugglers, spies, and terrorists.

Using only the documents provided by travelers and the Ministry of Admission's primitive inspect, search, and fingerprint systems you must decide who can enter Arstotzka and who will be turned away or arrested.

description:
Immerse yourself in the world of Dune.

Experience the ultimate blend of strategy and intrigue as you navigate the treacherous landscapes of Arrakis in the award-winning board game Dune: Imperium!

Battle online, locally with AI, or against the formidable House Hagal.
Earn Achievements that showcase your prowess as a leader.

Embark on more than a dozen Challenges that will test your wit and cunning.
Compete for badges in the rotating Skirmish Mode where no two games are the same!

Control the Spice. Control the Universe.

Arrakis. Dune. Desert Planet. Raise your banner above the vast wasteland before you. As the Great Houses of the Landsraad marshal their forces and their spies, whom will you influence, and whom will you betray? A tyrannical Emperor. The secretive Bene Gesserit. The shrewd Spacing Guild. The ferocious Fremen of the Deep Desert. The power of the Imperium can be yours, but war is not the only way to claim it.

Will you seek political allies or rely upon military might? Economic strength or subtle intrigues? A council seat… or a sharpened blade? The cards are dealt. The choice is yours. name: Poly Bridge 2
summary: The acclaimed bridge-building indie-hit is back and better than ever!
description:
New levels, new mechanics, a custom physics engine, and much more! Rediscover your engineering creativity with even more hours of puzzling fun!

Take on levels with some added cushion and bounce your way to victory with the new Spring material. Now your bridges can be even more flexible!

description:

Use certain crops and tiny guy parts to craft more tiny guys to help manage the terrace.

Use money produced from crops to buy decorations to detail your terrace.

name: Poppy Playtime Chapter 1

description:
You must stay alive in this horror/puzzle adventure. Try to survive the vengeful toys waiting for you in the abandoned toy factory. Use your GrabPack to hack electrical circuits or nab anything from afar. Explore the mysterious facility... and don't get caught.

name: Backpack Battles
summary: Auto Chess Inventory Game
description:
In Backpack Battles, you fight using items from your backpack. Your combat power depends on item choices, and most importantly, how you arrange them inside the backpack! Better arrangement means greater strength!

Items vary in size, shape, price, and rarity. Combine different items to craft even more powerful gear. Brew potent potions, forge legendary weapons, and even hatch dragon eggs!

You'll face the backpack setups of real players. Study their strategies and find ways to win.

Climb the ranks in Competitive Mode to see how high you can go, or relax in Casual Mode. Both modes are untimed—take your time to organize your backpack!

Join our community for discussion and support!
Discord: https://discord.gg/PKPGxFpgFA
Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/share/g/1AtWHngD8v/
